title: Design System: Patrice Beauty Lounge Aesthetics

display.purpose: Hero headline only; 2.75rem on phones to 4.25rem on desktop.

title.purpose: Card and category names, mobile menu items, footer column heads.

figure.purpose: Prices and admin KPI values, tabular lining numerals.

body-lead.purpose: Lead paragraphs under section headings and in the hero.

label.purpose: Form labels, buttons, small list headings.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Featured card, appointment card, overlapping photographs, toasts, hover state.

shadows.name: action-glow
shadows.purpose: Under the filled clay button only.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Every authored movement: hero rise, reveals, hover lift, press.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.value: translateY(12px) to none, opacity 0 to 1, 280ms ease-out-soft, 120ms + i * 60ms delay
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: hero lines settle in on load. Reduced motion keeps the fade only.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Section headings and cards settle as they enter; content is visible without JS; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Cards on hover, only under (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active feedback on buttons and pressable links.

components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #3B2A28; } .ds-input { display: block; margin-top: 0.375rem; height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid #E2CDC5; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #3B2A28; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7A6460; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C4877A; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4877A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.html: TreatmentsAboutResults
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1rem; background: rgb(251 246 243 / 0.9); border-bottom: 1px solid #ECDCD5; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 0.5rem 0.875rem; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: rgb(59 42 40 / 0.75); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0.875rem; right: 0.875rem; bottom: -2px; height: 1px; background: #C4877A; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #3B2A28; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4877A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; max-width: 22rem; padding: 2.25rem 1.75rem 2rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgb(236 220 213 / 0.8); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(59 42 40 / 0.04), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(59 42 40 / 0.14); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 220ms ease-out; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(59 42 40 / 0.04), 0 24px 48px -20px rgb(59 42 40 / 0.28); } } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4877A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Gilda Display', Didot, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.25; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3B2A28; } .ds-card-cat { margin-top: 0.375rem; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #8E4E3F; } .ds-card-body { margin-top: 1.5rem; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #5C4844; } .ds-card-price { margin-top: 1.25rem; font-family: 'Gilda Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.75rem; color: #3B2A28; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-card-price span { margin-right: 0.375rem; font-family: Geist, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #7A6460; }

narrative.overview:
The clinic should feel like a calm, warm room you can step into: rose-tinted light, blush walls, a classical serif on the door, white cards set down softly on a counter. Every surface is warm; nothing is grey, nothing is black. The palette steps from a pale rose canvas through blush fields to a rose clay for action and a deep cocoa for ink, so the whole product reads as one material.

Density is relaxed on the public site (generous bands, one idea per band) and working-dense in the admin, where the same palette and corners carry tables, charts and figures. The serif is the signature; the sans does the work. Full-width colour bands alternate canvas, blush and soft rose, with content held to one measure inside them.

The system refuses the category default: a centred stock hero over three icon cards and a pastel gradient. Depth is soft and warm (cocoa-tinted long shadows), motion is a quiet settle, never a show.
keyCharacteristics: Rose-tinted canvas, blush and soft-rose bands, edge to edge; content in an 82rem measure.
Gilda Display at one weight for headings and figures; Geist for everything read.
Soft 10px corner family on cards, media, controls; avatars round.
White cards with hairlines and cocoa-tinted long shadows.
One authored motion (the hero rise); everything else is a short ease-out state change.

rules.name: The Clay Never Reads Rule
rules.body: Rose Clay is a fill and a stroke, never text or a text background. Text on clay surfaces uses Clay Deep; links use Clay Ink.

rules.name: The Champagne On Cocoa Rule
rules.body: Champagne appears only on cocoa fields. On light surfaces it vanishes; use clay instead.

rules.name: The Honest Names Rule
rules.body: New call sites use canvas, clay, clay-deep, clay-ink, cocoa, cocoa-deep. The legacy aliases (ivory, rose, rose-deep, rose-ink, plum, plum-deep, violet, gold, gold-deep, lilac, mist, ink) map to these values so older components re-theme, and must not gain new call sites.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Gilda has one weight and no italic. Hierarchy comes from size and colour, never bold. An emphasised word in a heading is set upright in Clay Ink.

rules.name: The Sans In The Columns Rule
rules.body: In the admin shell, h3 and h4 switch to Geist; the serif stays for page titles and headline figures.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow labels above headings. A heading stands on its own.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: No neutral-grey or black shadows on light surfaces. Depth is cocoa or clay tinted.

dos: Do run every section background edge to edge and hold content in the gutter (82rem measure).
Do use Clay Deep for filled actions and Clay Ink for links; keep Rose Clay for fills, rules and focus.
Do set headings and figures in Gilda Display at its one weight; use size and colour for hierarchy.
Do tint every shadow to cocoa (Soft at rest, Lift for featured and hover).
Do keep corners in the 10px family; avatars and thumbnails round.
Do keep motion to one authored hero rise (12px, 60ms stagger, 280ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); scroll reveals use the same values. Under reduced motion keep the fades, drop the movement.
Do gate hover lifts behind hover-capable fine pointers; press feedback is scale(0.97).
Do read chart colours only from the --chart-* tokens.
donts: Don't put eyebrow labels or kickers above headings.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy.
Don't bold or italicise Gilda Display.
Don't use Champagne on light surfaces, or Rose Clay as a text colour.
Don't add new call sites for the legacy aliases (ivory, rose, plum, gold, ink and the rest); use the honest names.
Don't use grey or black shadows on light surfaces, or hard offset shadows.
Don't box the page in a centred container with side margins of bare canvas.
Don't rebuild the category default: a centred stock hero over three icon cards on a pastel gradient.
